name: Chevron Reel
description: Full-screen WebGL image reel where columns of curved photos form two chevron-shaped streams that move with page scroll velocity, looping infinitely.
contents: Fixed full-screen WebGL canvas with columns of images arranged in two rotated groups
behavior: Smooth infinite scrolling through Lenis drives the image columns
Images wrap around endlessly and bend with a cosine curve shader
Scroll velocity displaces the images, optionally smoothed
editableByProps: Images, direction, column layout, curvature and speed per column
Background color, camera distance, scroll smoothing, Lenis options, loader visibility

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image cropping or add color effects
Change the bend shape of the images

fixed: Canvas is position fixed and covers the whole viewport
Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when includeLenis is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
